detail.name: Term Deposit
detail.description: Term Deposits allow you to lock away funds and earn a fixed interest rate for a set period, so you know exactly how much money you will earn. You can start with investing as little as $1,000. Term Deposits with terms of three, six or nine months automatically have interest paid at maturity. The interest may be paid to a savings account or reinvested. For terms of 12 months or longer, you can have interest paid to your savings account as regularly as fortnightly, monthly, quarterly or annually - it’s your choice!

fees.name: Term Deposit Withdrawal
fees.additionalValue: When you request to withdraw part or all of your term deposit funds prior to the maturity date, the contracted interest will be paid to you on the amount withdrawn early, reflecting the proportion of the contracted term elapsed when the earned interest is paid to you. An administration fee of $20 will also apply. This administration fee will be deducted from the amount of interest that will be paid to you.

detail.name: Bonus Savings Account
detail.description: Earn a great bonus rate each month if you make a deposit of any amount and no withdrawals with our Bonus Savings Account. It doesn’t matter if you deposit $1 or $1,000 each month, either way you can earn bonus interest. Best of all, there’s no maximum or minimum balance requirements, so you can have as much or as little as you like sitting in your account.

detail.name: 55+ Account
detail.description: Our 55+ Account is a transaction account available to all members aged 55 and over. It offers you the ability to earn higher returns without having to lock funds away and has no monthly account keeping fees. Whether you’re working, receiving a pension or retired, that combination is hard to beat. You can request a free Visa Debit Card with payWave which you can load into Google Pay, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay and Garmin Pay. Now you can pay for purchases using your smart device, wherever mobile payment systems are offered. Get unbeatable security through measures such as the Visa Zero Liability policy (which protects against unauthorised transactions) and our own 24/7 fraud monitoring service. You’ll also be able to temporarily lock your card (if you misplace it), plus block payWave, international and online transactions whenever you need to – using the Mobile Banking App or Internet Banking. Online banking with this account is available 24/7 with Internet Banking and our Mobile Banking App. Internet banking will provide you with eStatements as well as the means to securely message each other, reducing paper and postage costs.
